items.title: [正面] I'm not at the end game content people have compla...
items.summary:
I'm not at the end game content people have complained about recently (as of late-summer 2026) but I've got decent hours on mobile especially and I've loved this game's soundtrack, writing, characterizations, and gameplay loop.

My partner plays as well, he deep-dives into mechanics to play things optimally and to overcome the challenges. I play it by grinding resources and following builds online that are just strong enough to feel fun so I can keep reading the story. We both love it.

items.summary: Очень милая, приятная и красивая игра, которой можно только пожелать успехов в поиске своей аудитории, чтобы та помогла ей стать более огранённой.
